patch_description: Rather than repeatedly descending from one incumbent, this approach keeps a small, diverse archive of evaluated networks and allocates LP calls in ranked batches. It borrows the useful bottleneck-price signal and surrogate energy from earlier approaches, but combines them with an archive-based search: candidate switches are ranked by directional price relief and energy, while a separate slice of each batch preserves exploration. Promising networks are retained based on both LP quality and edge-set diversity, giving the search more chances to leave a local basin. Repaired QAOA samples seed the archive, and multi-switch perturbations provide fallback proposals when ordinary switches are exhausted.
